proposal.summary: Neo Billing version 3.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability: an attacker with a customer (regular user) account can submit crafted payloads in ticket 'Subject' (title) or 'Description' (content) fields via /neo/crm/tickets/addticket which are stored and later rendered on /neo/crm/tickets or ticket thread pages.
proposal.cwe_quote: Due to improper input fields data filtering, version 3.5 (and possibly previous versions), are affected by a stored XSS vulnerability.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the stored XSS by submitting a benign scripted payload in title and content as a customer, confirm where the payload is rendered, and identify all affected pages and templates; then recommend output encoding/HTML sanitization on ticket title/content and implement server-side input validation and escaping.

evidence_quotes.quote: Due to improper input fields data filtering, version 3.5 (and possibly previous versions), are affected by a stored XSS vulnerability.
Closing an input field tag and injecting code into 'Subject' or 'Description' text fields [//host/neo/crm/tickets/addticket]

evidence_quotes.claim: Payload is stored and where it appears
